title: Declare or disposition undeclared condition-name reference leaves outside condition records
description: Found while designing condition->condition relationships (docs/design/condition-condition-relationships.md C6, eshyra-o9bd.19.3.4.2). Condition-name leaves with the same fail-open shape (no relationship declaration, so discovery never follows them) exist outside condition records. Snapshot at de7df402 (membership must come from a generated query, not these counts): creature /actions|legendaryActions|reactions|traits/*/mechanics/conditions/*/condition (~359 leaves) -> owner eshyra-o9bd.19.4.2/.3; ancestry /traits/*/mechanics/conditions/*/condition (5) -> eshyra-o9bd.19.3.1; magic-item /mechanics/effects/*/conditions/* (18, includes non-condition values suffocating/any-disease) and /mechanics/effects/*/failedSaveCondition (9, includes 'one exhaustion level') -> eshyra-o9bd.19.4.5. Also: (a) whether /mechanics/effects/*/condition belongs in LEGACY_RELATIONSHIP_BEARING_POINTER_SHAPES (it is overloaded: prose preconditions in magic-item/creature/feature/action/spell, condition names in condition records) with explicit not-a-reference declarations per kind; (b) the five existing mechanics.conditions record-name declarations carry a placeholder relation 'condition' always overridden by the sibling (required-field-filled-mechanically idiom) - migrate them to relationByFieldValue or a declared vocabulary once C1 lands. Uses the C1/C2 resolver generalization from the condition design.
notes:
2026-10-09 bounded review (Claude Captain, main a961fb0b; requested by the resume campaign). QUESTION: do the undeclared condition-name leaves violate an operative live-discovery invariant, or are they a bounded limitation ADR 0020 permits to remain disclosed? FINDINGS: (1) Producer/gate: the only coverage gate over relationship-bearing leaves, assertRecordRelationshipDeclarationsCoverBoundedShapes (packages/core/src/rules/recordRelationships.ts ~L574-623), covers exactly seven top-level pointer shapes incl. '/mechanics/conditions/*/condition'; the nested creature '/actions|legendaryActions|reactions|traits/*/mechanics/conditions/*/condition', ancestry '/traits/*/...', and magic-item '/mechanics/effects/*/conditions/*' and failedSaveCondition leaves are outside it, and its own doc forbids widening it into a coverage claim over RulesRecord.data (ADR 0020 section 6). The manifest rule 'every declared reference yields exactly one typed outcome' binds declared references only. No violation of either. (2) Accepted authority: docs/design/condition-condition-relationships.md C6 and section 7 explicitly scope these leaves OUT of the condition repair and record them here; no domain bead AC (19.4.2, 19.4.3, 19.3.1, 19.4.5) requires them (19.4.3 and 19.4.5 notes defer them to this bead). (3) Consumer/consequence: expansion is one hop (expandTypedRelationships), so a creature/ancestry/item record seeded by state-ref does not pull in the condition record it may impose; the condition is still reachable by name-mention signals (signals.ts ~L150-190, player input), by DM lookup_rules on the condition, and the imposing record's verbatim text names the condition. Consequence is reduced discoverability of condition text in creature-driven situations, not a wrong rule, wrong state, or false provenance. DISPOSITION: legitimate bounded discovery limitation under ADR 0020 (no universal discovery completeness); retain independent ownership here; NOT re-freeze-blocking; it must be disclosed as an explicit unresolved discovery limit (re-freeze bar #9) in the candidate bundle (eshyra-o9bd.19.6.3). Item (b) (placeholder relation 'condition' always overridden by sibling) produces no wrong edge; it is a representation-quality item kept here, not a live defect. No dependency change.
PLAN (Captain 2026-11-07; user direction: repair pre-freeze, no longer a disclosed limit). Base: origin/main e4740161.
GOAL: every condition-name leaf outside condition records yields exactly one declared, typed outcome: a resolved record-name reference to the condition, or an explicit not-a-reference. The declarations are importer-emitted (packages/core/scripts/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/recordRelationshipDeclarations.ts -> packs/rules__dnd5e-srd-5.1/record-relationships.json via emit.ts), so docs/importer-fix-protocol.md governs; regenerate with npm run import:dnd5e-srd and confirm with npm run verify:dnd5e-srd-pack. Never hand-edit generated files.
MEMBERSHIP: derive it from a generated query over records.json: every string leaf named condition, conditions[] or failedSaveCondition inside any mechanics object, at any depth, for every kind other than condition. These are leads, not the list (main 64a9a044): creature actions/*, legendaryActions/entries/*, reactions/*, traits/* .../mechanics/conditions/*/condition (218+30+1+110); ancestry traits/*/mechanics/conditions/*/condition (5); magic-item mechanics/effects/*/conditions/* (17; sibling kind is imposesCondition, triggeredEffect or immunity) and mechanics/effects/*/failedSaveCondition (8); equipment use-profile leaves (e.g. equipment:ball-bearings-bag-of-1-000 -> prone; find the shape); action:dodge mechanics/effects/*/conditions/* holds the ENDING circumstances you-are-incapacitated and your-speed-is-0, which are not condition references; and the overloaded /mechanics/effects/*/condition shape in non-condition kinds (prose preconditions; bead item a) wherever it is emitted.
RELATION VOCABULARY (bead item b): replace the placeholder relation 'condition' with relationField 'relation' with C1 relationByFieldValue tables (docs/design/condition-condition-relationships.md C1/C2, already landed), for the five existing top-level declarations and the new nested ones. Enumerate the emitted sibling values from the query (seen: applies, removes, prevents, advantage, disadvantage, immune, suppresses, gates, exclusion, mention) and map each to a relation name. Use null (excluded) only where the leaf does not name a condition related to the record, and justify each null against source text. Unrecognized values must stay indeterminate (the resolver already does this). Magic-item effects/*/conditions/*: relationField kind, with each table entry checked against the printed clause; failedSaveCondition: a fixed relation (C2) only if every occurrence verifies.
NON-CONDITION VALUES: 'suffocating' (Dust of Sneezing and Choking) is not a condition record. It must not resolve to a wrong record, invent a condition, or be counted as a silent miss. Either (i) correct the importer so the value is represented truthfully outside the condition list (only if an existing field already carries that meaning; no new schema invention), or (ii) keep it with its typed unresolved-target outcome asserted by an exact test and stated in the declaration reason. Report which you chose and why. Any other non-condition value the query finds gets the same treatment.
GATE: extend the bounded coverage gate (assertRecordRelationshipDeclarationsCoverBoundedShapes and LEGACY_RELATIONSHIP_BEARING_POINTER_SHAPES in packages/core/src/rules/recordRelationships.ts, or a sibling bounded constant) with the explicitly enumerated new shapes, so an undeclared emitted leaf at any of them throws. It stays an enumerated, bounded list: never a claim over RulesRecord.data as a whole (ADR 0020 section 6); keep the doc comments truthful.
DISCLOSURE: packages/core/scripts/create-dnd5e-srd-audit-bundle/candidateGates.ts points at eshyra-o9bd.19.3.5 as an open discovery limit; update it to what remains true (eshyra-ry69's record-key leaves remain). Do NOT edit the dated candidate-record docs under docs/audits (history; eshyra-o9bd.19.6.7.22 writes the successor), freeze-manifest.json, or thaw notes.
EVIDENCE (proportionate, per AGENTS.md Permanent Test Evidence): resolver/gate tests with synthetic manifests for anything new in the contract; source-backed regressions on real records: creature:aboleth Enslave -> condition:charmed resolved; one ancestry, one magic-item imposesCondition, one immunity, ball bearings -> prone; action:dodge ending circumstances not-a-reference; the suffocating outcome; one discovery test showing that a seeded creature record's one-hop expansion now reaches the condition record. Review and explain the generated diff (only record-relationships.json and the expected discovery goldens should move; records.json should not change unless option (i) is taken).
REPORT: affected shapes with before/after outcome counts per (kind, shape, outcome); generated diff summary; exact commands and results.
